newsitem.title: USA: Texas Instruments Inc Q4 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Texas Instruments Inc Q4 loss vs profit.

text.p: Shr loss $0.15 profit $1.50
Net loss 29,000 profit 291,000
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
YEAR
Shr profit $0.33 profit $5.63
Net profit 63,000 profit 1,088,000
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Net results include discontinued operations income.
Q4 income from discontinued operations $11 million or $0.06 per share vs $23 million or $0.12 per share.
Year income from discontinued operations $109 million or $0.57 per share vs $92 million or $0.48 per share.
Excluding discontinued operations, loss per share in fourth quarter was $0.21 vs profit $1.38.
Excluding discontinued operations, loss per share in year was $0.24 vs profit $5.15.
Discontinued operations refer to defense business, which is being sold to Raytheon Co
1996 Q4 and year results include several one-time charges and asset write-downs.
1996 Q4 unusual items include $91 million severance costs and $117 million asset write-downs principally affecting mobile computing.
In addition to Q4 charges, 1996 year includes $192 million research and development write-off associated with acquisition of Silicon Systems Inc.
((-- New York Newsdesk, 212-859-1610))
